user.title: OKP Cloud Login
user.description: Enter the account and password of the OKP robot vacuum app.

reauth.title: OKP Cloud Re-authentication
reauth.description:
The login token has expired. Re-enter your account and password to restore the connection.

Note: an OKP account allows only one login session at a time, so submitting this form signs the phone app out. Likewise, logging into the app invalidates the integration's session - that is a cloud-side limit.

reauth_confirm.title: OKP Cloud Re-authentication
reauth_confirm.description:
The login token has expired. Re-enter your account and password to restore the connection.

Note: submitting the password login temporarily signs the phone app out (the OKP cloud allows a single session). In most cases no password is needed: the integration first tries to recover the session silently with the CoolKit refresh token; this form only appears when that token is dead too.

reconfigure.title: OKP Cloud Reconfigure
reconfigure.description: Update the OKP cloud account and password.

share.title: OKP shared account (the way to run the app and this integration together)

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the OKP server. Check your network and try again.
error.no_device: No robot vacuum device found under this account
error.invalid_appid: Invalid appid (a CoolKit appid is usually 32 characters)

init.title: OKP options
init.description: Realtime push keeps a WebSocket open, like the app does, so state changes show up within a second while the robot cleans. It is also what keeps the cloud session in use - with it off the session expires more easily.

data.coolkit_appid:
CoolKit appid (leave empty to use the OKP app id)
Only needed if the same account is also used by another CoolKit-branded app (eWeLink etc.). With it set, this integration shares that app's session and OKP app logins no longer displace it.

state.rt: Self-renewing (app logins do not affect it)
state.okplife: Depends on the login token (app logins invalidate it)

move.name: Manual remote
move.description: Drive the robot like the app joystick: press a direction, and the integration releases it for you. A duration presses and releases automatically; duration 0 holds until direction=stop (auto-released after 10 s).

set_timer.name: Enable/disable schedule
set_timer.description: Turn one device-side cleaning schedule on or off by its mId. Re-reads the schedule list first, changes only that entry, and verifies the result.

refresh_session.name: Refresh cloud session
refresh_session.description: Exchange the stored refresh token (rt) for a new access token right now and return the outcome. Useful to debug a dropped session or to check that it no longer depends on the phone app.

rescan_devices.name: Rescan devices
rescan_devices.description: Re-reads the account's device list and picks up robots added (or shared) in the app, without ever asking for the password. New devices are merged into the entry and the integration reloads itself; 'added' in the response lists what was found.
